sources.name: actions-e
sources.annotationMethod: Manual torso/pelvis center X and row-shared ground Y; approximately +/-5 to 8 native pixels. Cap ROI and alpha128 sole spans are diagnostics, never per-frame scaling or lowest-boot pivots.
limitations: Simplified two-state muzzleloading; this is not a certified full drill or exact weapon model.
Low-alpha colored RGB residue and ghost pixels remain unchanged; all measured saturated-blue residue is below alpha8.
Single held firing pose and two reload samples do not provide recoil settling or smooth loading.
Full-family, production, historical and human-anatomical approval remain false.

sources.name: march-se
sources.annotationMethod: Manual torso/pelvis X and row-shared ground Y; approximately +/-5 to 8 native pixels. One common source reference preserves gait/posture differences; no per-phase boot or cap normalization.
limitations: Alternating contact and passing legs are plausible by thigh/knee/occlusion review, not skeletal or human-anatomical certification.
Body-span variation and source placement remain visible under one common scale; generated cloth and equipment are not guaranteed physically continuous.
Low-alpha RGB residue remains untouched; padding is verified at alpha64, not at every nonzero alpha.
Only SE march is supported; ready, fire, reload, melee and casualty use accepted fallback for this bearing.
Production and full-family approval remain false pending complete coverage and named-device performance review.
